run_bm_ball_query: run the ball query benchmark across multiple test cases on CPU and CUDA devices
run_ball_query_square: run a single ball query benchmark case with specified N, P1, P2, D, K, radius, and device parameters
test_ball_query_square: test the ball_query_square function with custom point cloud sizes and search radius on a given device
review_bm_ball_query: review the bm_ball_query benchmark configuration including batch sizes, point counts, dimensions, and radii
summarize_ball_query_square: summarize the ball_query_square function which generates random point clouds and runs ball_query with skip_points_outside_cube enabled
